in_marathi.name: Dilesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dilesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Dilesh is derived from the words ‘Dila’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Isha’ meaning ‘Lord’ or ‘Messenger’. This name is given to a child believed to be a messenger of God.
